_comment: How each machine reaches the lab share. The catalog stores paths relative
to it, so a library catalogued from a Mac and the same library catalogued
from Windows come out identical -- see app/share.py.
server_root is how THIS server reaches the share. Use the UNC path, not a
mapped drive: mapped drives belong to a logged-in session and do not exist
for a Windows service, so L:\ resolves to nothing once SpecVault runs as
mounts is every prefix a person might paste, and which flavour of path to
show them back. CHECK THE mac AND linux PREFIXES against how people
actually mount the share -- a prefix that is wrong here does not break
anything quietly, it rejects those users' paths as 'not on the share'.
require_on_share: false lets libraries outside the share be catalogued.
Leave it true -- an entry nobody else can open defeats the point.
